key_reasoning.reason: New workflows/contracts package (models, settings reader, simulator, derive, effects, policy, linker, input-contract stage, protocols) plus validation/tool_schemas.py resolver; new abstractions (ContractLinkReport, ToolSchemaResolver protocol, mode policy) hooked into validate_workflow, resource stage and workflow.py. All inside a single repo.

No exact precedent: graph-wide save-time simulation that can reject user workflows (strict mode) with warning-ceiling corpus gating, failure isolation so the linker never raises, per-save resolver state, and sanitised names interpolated into
error markup. Extensive edge-case/corpus test suites were required. Rollback is softened by the mode policy (warn vs strict).

34 files changed (11406 insertions): ~13 new contracts/validation modules, ~13 test files, and modified workflow_models, constants, workflow.py, validation resources/schema/__init__, execution_config_schema.yaml and the openapi baseline.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk: save-path validation rejection and sanitisation of names rendered into HTML-style error strings (security-sensitive, no pre-existing reusable util)
Component Scope: touches the shared workflow save/validate path (validate_workflow, resource stage, workflow models)
